lines.reason: Framing question with no factual claim and no claims.
The 2025 Chamber report says '58% of small businesses say they use generative AI'. The source, figure, year and self-reported framing all match.
The Fed note cites Census survey data: 'about 18 percent of firms have adopted AI as of year-end 2025'. The line correctly scopes this to all firms and any AI.

BofA excerpt: owners who integrated AI use it for 'marketing (50%), content production (38%), customer service (37%)'. The order matches. 'Owners using AI' fits the base, which mixes small and mid-sized owners.
Goldman Sachs 10KSB survey from Sept to Oct 2025: '85% said it has increased their efficiency and productivity'. The paragraph is about AI users. 'Raised their productivity' is a fair shortening.
Excerpt: 'Four out of five small businesses that use GenAI have seen productivity increase by 20% or more.' The figure and threshold match.
Excerpt: 'The biggest barriers to adoption are a lack of technical expertise and fears around data privacy and security.'
Closing advice. It makes no factual claim and has no claims.
